rules.statement: The State must honor legitimate expectations held by individuals, especially when such expectations arise from promises made by its officials acting on behalf of the State.
rules.supporting_quote: 'It is to be recalled that one of the grounds on which the decision in Robertson v. Minister of Pensions (Supra) was rested was that the Crown was bound by the war office letter (to the effect that Robertson's disability was attributable to military service) as the War office was an agent for the crown. And as the crown was bound, so were its (crown's) other departments.'
